articles.summary: DineSafe spoke at the Central Texas Chapter Spring Conference, on May 16th - 2024, in San Marcos, Texas. Our presentation focused on leveraging consumer crowdsourcing in identifying food safety trends in real-time. Read more about the details of Central Texas’s Spring event here.
articles.title: DineSafe to Speak at Central Texas Environmental Health Association Conference 2024

articles.summary: DineSafe owns the leading consumer food safety platform, Iwaspoisoned.com. This platform allows consumers globally to share their food safety experiences. With native support for seven languages, we've received reports from over 170 countries.
articles.title: Visualizing Our Global Consumer Reporting Footprint
